card.name: Verbs reporting trial durations and averages
card.fires_on: Linking verbs and small words right before a number or range in clinical trial results, such as 'ranged', 'was', 'average', and 'to' after a duration.

modes.label: Duration range verbs
modes.description: Verb or 'to' leading into a time span in months or years.
modes.example: The duration of clinically significant cytopenia in the reported cases has<< ranged>> from approximately 2 months to approximately

modes.label: Average or median phrasing
modes.description: 'average' or 'was' introducing a typical amount or treatment length.
modes.example: patients required an<< average>> of 5 tablets per day to increase

modes.label: Reporting or discontinuing
modes.description: A verb or 'due' leading into a rate or reason in trial results.
modes.example: 2.5% of participants discontinued LILETTA<< due>> to bleeding complaints.
